about: Cues rendered by the engine before an instrument with no effect lost its effects chain, when every cue instrument had one. A cue that renders differently from these sounds different from before.
how: The document in cues.effects.render.test.ts loaded into an engine on a 1.5 s mono offline context, then playCue(name, 0.128), with UPDATE_RENDER_REFERENCE=1; samples copied out of the AudioBuffer at once.
